records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] In UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java (same in UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.java), the feature-disabled path conflates a usage error (missing --features=rolling-updates flag on the CLI call) with a check outcome: it reports via FEATURE_DISABLED exit code documented in the operator doc table as a check result, so scripts cannot distinguish a caller error from a deployment verdict and misclassify fixable invocation errors as environment verdicts
records.rationale: The diff adds a hard gate in both commands: `if (!Profile.isFeatureEnabled(Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES)) { ... picocli.exit(CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED); return; }` (UpdateCompatibilityCheck/Metadata). This makes the command return exit code 4 whenever the preview feature isn’t enabled—regardless of whether that’s because the caller omitted `--features=rolling-updates` or because the environment/config disables it.
